offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures piston single-engine aircraft and a single-engine personal jet, sold to private owners, flight schools and businesses. Sales run through a worldwide dealer network, and the company also provides pilot training and aircraft support.

primary_products.value: piston single-engine aircraft; single-engine personal jet

primary_services.value: pilot training; aircraft maintenance and support; aircraft service centers

customer_segment.value: B2C: private aircraft owners and individual pilots; B2B: flight schools, charter operators, corporate flight departments

end_markets.value: general aviation; flight training; business aviation; air charter

revenue_model.value: product sales: new aircraft sold to owners and operators; service fees: pilot training, maintenance, and support services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs and builds aircraft from purchased components, sold to dealers and owners; service provider: pilot training and maintenance for aircraft owners and operators

geography_served.value: global: sells and supports aircraft through dealers across North America, Europe, Asia and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: piston aircraft, personal jet, pilot training and aircraft support

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent aircraft sales dealers worldwide; direct sales: factory sales to owners and operators; own locations: factory and training center in Duluth, Minnesota
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: high: aircraft certification and production approval from FAA and EASA, plus airworthiness rules
